BLAKE3 C implementation, version 1.8.7 (BLAKE3_VERSION_STRING in blake3.h).

Source: the c/ directory of the blake3 crate 1.8.7 (crates.io), which is the
c/ directory of https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3 at tag 1.8.7, copied
unchanged.  Licence: CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
(LICENSE_CC0, LICENSE_A2, LICENSE_A2LLVM, the crate's own licence files).
Only the C intrinsics files are kept (no assembly, no TBB, no CMake, and
not README.md, whose relative links name files not copied).

Used by: host/native/fn-blake3.c (lane digest-native's prototype: Bao-style
verified streaming), built by tools/build_blake3.sh.  Not loaded by any
served image.
